0022600015.text: The Wizards (2-3, 1-1 at home) host the Hornets (3-2, first in the Southeast) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, Washington's sixth game of the season, with Washington on a two-game losing streak and Charlotte coming off a one-game loss. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Tre Johnson (Achilles, soreness), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The Wizards trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 110-103 in Charlotte on October 26, and they lost all four meetings with the Hornets in 2025-26.
